subject: Need the bed in place before Christmas?
preheader: Allow time for the home trial, an OT review and any changes before the holiday break.
sectionTitle: Leave time for what comes after the trial
body: If a bed or mattress needs to be in place before Christmas, the seven nights at home are one part of the timeline. There may also be an OT review, funding approval, a final quote and delivery to arrange.
For the person and their family, having the setup settled can mean one less worry heading into the break.
We can help work through the equipment options, organise the home trial and coordinate quotes and delivery planning.
actionTitle: Let’s work backwards from when it’s needed
actionText: If a trial or quote is already underway, let us know where it is up to. We’ll help identify the next practical step, check availability and confirm what timing is realistic for that setup before Christmas.
ctaLabel: DISCUSS A BED OR MATTRESS NEED
trialFooterText: Seven-night in-home trial availability, service area, equipment configuration and individual arrangements are confirmed per case.
intro: At Sleep Choice, we work with OTs, care teams and families to arrange seven-night therapeutic bed and mattress trials in the person’s home.
The trial gives the person and their OT time to assess the setup in daily use. If a different option is needed, it helps to have time to work through that too.
actionLead: You do not need to have chosen the exact bed or mattress to start. Reply with a few de-identified lines about:
actionPoints: The suburb where it is needed
The date you are working towards
